services.name: Go Glamping
services.desc: A midweek yurt stay designed around real schedules. Enjoy a full 24 hours with flexible timing. The yurt has limited space and power, so we’re keeping things simple. We suggest you do the same. See below for what to expect of this basic kitchenette. You are also welcome to use the gas grill which is located in the covered pavilion (you may want snowshoes to get over there:). We recommend one pot meals, snack boards, reheats or packets for the grill. Bring a cooler if you have food to chill. 9 am-9 am: check in, coffee, knit, snooze, read a book, soup, get a great night of sleep and head home in the morning. services.name: whole hub rental
services.desc: Spend a weekend with 20 or more of your favorite people! Spread out and relax, enjoying the private space of your room or glamping site, then come together in the common gathering spaces of the Pavilion and Lodge. Make use of two large, well equipped kitchens, your choice of fire pits, ample space for games and lounging. Best of all, know that you’re group has the whole place to yourselves! The Whole Hub rental can be used as accommodations and gathering for your specified number of guests. Please speak with your hosts ahead of time regarding additional visitors or to plan an event.
